project: Collector Parfum - Luxury Refill Perfume Shop

depth_system.grain_overlay: pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 opacity-[0.035] mix-blend-overlay z-[99] bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml,...')]

section_1_discovery_hub.subtitle: Temukan wewangian impian berdasarkan Brand favorit, Karakter aroma, Pilihan Editor, atau Best Seller teratas.

brand.layout: Search bar top + Horizontal slider of Brand Tiles
brand.search_input: Input field with Search icon, placeholder 'Cari dari 200+ Brand (e.g. Chanel, Creed, Le Labo)...'
brand.card_style: Bordered glass card with brand title, total product count badge (e.g. '18 Parfum'), and a mini 3-product thumbnail gallery or bottle art strip

character.layout: Search bar top + Horizontal slider of Scent Character Cards (~40 characters)
character.search_input: Input field with Search icon, placeholder 'Cari Karakter (e.g. Elegant, Fresh, Masculine, Woody)...'
character.card_style: Compact tactile card with Lucide icon in gold circle, Character Name, short mood description, product count, click action to filter shop

editor_picks.layout: Horizontal Embla slider of Editor Choice perfume cards
editor_picks.card_style: Automatic top featured products with gold 'Kurasi Editor' floating badge, fragrance note breakdown (Top/Heart/Base), curator review quote, and direct 'Pilih Ukuran' CTA button

best_seller.layout: Horizontal slider of Ranked product cards
best_seller.card_style: Rank badge (#1, #2, #3 in gold metallic finish), sales metric label (e.g. 'Terjual 1.2k+ bulan ini'), star rating, and full ProductCard details

sections_to_keep_and_update.kategori: Checkbox list (Refill Parfum, Discovery Set, Perfume Oil, Atomizer)
sections_to_keep_and_update.brand: Searchable combobox with real-time text filter (~200 brands). Selected brands displayed as removable golden chips
sections_to_keep_and_update.character: Searchable combobox replacing chip grid (~40 characters). Users type to search and select characters with badge counter
sections_to_keep_and_update.momen: Single segmented toggle for 'Day & Night' (replacing old 'Date Night' label)

section_3_global_depth_and_polish.cards: Subtle 1px border border-[var(--cp-champagne)]/40 with soft backdrop blur and ambient shadow. Rounded-xl or rounded-2xl
section_3_global_depth_and_polish.buttons: Primary CTA uses gold liquid shimmer hover effect (`.cp-btn-gold`), rounded-full with subtle press down active state (`active:scale-[0.98]`)
section_3_global_depth_and_polish.animations: Framer Motion layout animations on tab switch (`layoutId='activeTab'`), slide-in fade effects (`initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}`)
section_3_global_depth_and_polish.micro_interactions: Icon rotation on hover, scale-105 image zooms inside overflow-hidden card frames

testing_guidelines.rule: Every interactive element must include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
